message: 憂と優

name: Synn
message: 「I'm hooome~~」
With that, he collapses face-first onto his futon.

name: Paqy
message: 「What's up, Demon Lord? You look wiped out.」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmm~ Today was just one big exercise in futility after another~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, you get days like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even at the closing meeting, nobody had any energy. Hope they're not feeling too down.」

name: Paqy
message: 「They aren't the type to let something like that get 'em down.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, true.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm, wonder who that is.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Grand Palace Sakura.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, Synn? It's me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, Nanaka. Home already?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nope, still on my way back. Honestly, Sacchin shows zero mercy.」

name: Synn
message: 「You lost the bet, so you can't really complain.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It was super tasty, though~♪ I ended up getting seconds without thinking.」

name: Synn
message: 「If you eat too much, you're gonna put on weight, you know.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm fine, I'm fine! I was making plenty of noise and moving around just as much!」

name: Synn
message: 「Fat around your stomach doesn't come off that easily.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's that supposed to mean, Synn? So you wouldn't complain if that fat went to my boobs instead?」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's not what I meant, though......」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mfufu~. You dirty pervert.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha--!? In that case, I'd love for you to get a killer body that actually makes my heart race!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, you asked for it! Don't blame me when you get a massive nosebleed!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nobody gets nosebleeds like that anymore!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What, you look totally fine」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Yeah, I'm fine」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tch, what a rip-off」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm out 10 yen! Pay up!」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's unreasonable...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just kidding, it's a joke. Heehee, sounded just like you, didn't I, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if I thought that, I wouldn't say it out loud!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tahaha--」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hm?」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks, okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Wh-Th-That's so sudden, no fair...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, see you tomorrow」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, wait! Hold on--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Your face is bright red」

name: Synn
message: 「Sh-Shut up」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka again...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, thanks for your business. Sakura Fisheries here! What'll your order be?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'm sorry! Wrong number」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Grand Palace Sakura.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, what was that just now!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What do you mean?」

name: Misa
message: 「What on earth is 'Sakura Fisheries' supposed to be!?」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Maybe you dialed the wrong number?」

name: Misa
message: 「It's the exact same number as before! Honestly, you're still joking around at a time like this?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, sorry. I just never expected you to call me, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, fine. Calling you out of the blue like this was rather rude of me too...」

name: Synn
message: 「So, did you need something?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, yeah. About Aseru... I'll call our match a draw for now」

name: Synn
message: 「Were we even having a match?」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, you can't exactly measure how close two people are, can you? Besides, boys and girls getting all buddy-buddy is far too impure to condone」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so? For example, I think you and I get along really well, Misa...」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't say such stupid things. You are my rival. Not a worthy adversary, just a plain rival. There's no way friendship could ever bloom in a relationship like that」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that how it is...」

name: Misa
message: 「In the first place, between a guy and a girl, rather than friendship--」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm?」

name: Misa
message: 「N-Nothing! There's no way anything like that could ever happen anyway」

name: Synn
message: 「What, what?」

name: Misa
message: 「Anyway! Starting tomorrow, we're competing in a different field, got it? Consider this a declaration of war. Bye」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh. Good night」

name: Misa
message: 「Good night」

name: Synn
message: 「Was that Misa's own way of cheering me up?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tough call, man」

name: Synn
message: 「Again?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Grand Palace Sakura.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Have I finally reached the President's residence!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, hey... Just how many wrong numbers did you dial, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, thank goodness. It really is you, President. Good evening」

name: Synn
message: 「You didn't save my number in your cell phone?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What is that?」

name: Synn
message: 「...I'll teach you next time. So, what's up?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. Regarding today's Student Council activities, I am thoroughly appalled at my own incompetence.」

name: Synn
message: 「Really?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「After talking so big, I think it was a massive failure.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So, you see. I'm looking for a way to be a bit more useful, but...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Would you happen to have any good ideas?」

name: Synn
message: 「Say, Lolotte. Why do you want to get along with Azel so badly?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Um, well. Among my old acquaintances, there were many people similar to the transfer student.」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Many...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's why I can't think of it as someone else's problem, and I just end up sticking my neck in.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's 'stick your nose in' or 'butt in.' Though, I think being meddlesome is good too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Do you think so?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. After all, being alone isn't any fun, right? Or do you prefer being alone, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, of course not! Being alone in my room like this is so lonely, I hate it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, me too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I wonder if the transfer student isn't lonely...」

name: Synn
message: 「He might not be lonely, but he sure didn't look like he was having fun.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Having fun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you already forget our declaration of resolve?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「'Leave your sparkling academy life to the Ryuusei Student Council!' Right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Just like that! We've got to make all the students sparkle」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Indeed!」
Thank goodness. Looks like she cheered up a bit.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Um, Mr. President. Would it be alright if I called you like this from time to time?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I don't mind」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you very much! Then, next time please teach me how to do that number registration thing!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure. Goodnight, then」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Goodnight」

name: Synn
message: 「The phone sure is busy tonight」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're Mr. Popular, man」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha-- I-I'm telling you, that's not it\s01」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Still, you haven't gotten a call from Ria-chan」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Grand Palace Sakura.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hello, is this the Sakura residence? My name is Ria Kujou. Is Synn Sakura-kun there?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, this is Synn」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, thank goodness♪」

name: Synn
message: 「It's an apartment phone, but I'm the only one here, so it's fine」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, old habit. Sorry about that\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Heh heh heh, tough luck」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, were you in the middle of something?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, not at all」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, you see. While I was taking a bath, something popped into my head and got me curious, so I called」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, so that means you just got out of the bath?」

name: Ria
message: 「Mmmm~~♪ Feels so good~~♪」
I-I wonder where Ria-senpai washes first, *thump-thump*...

name: Ria
message: 「Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, sorry! So, what did you want to talk about?」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, it's about Azel--」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha. I knew you were worried about her too, Ria-senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh? What do you mean?」

name: Synn
message: 「It wasn't just me--everyone on the Student Council actually called me about her」

name: Ria
message: 「Wow... Everyone really does care about her, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「That just shows how much of a shock it was for them」

name: Ria
message: 「I see. Was everyone okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, totally. None of them are the type to let something like this get them down」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee, true」

name: Ria
message: 「You know, my big sister was unusually worried too. Even after we got home, she asked me all sorts of questions... It felt kinda weird~」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be that she's actually a princess of Sharo-Ma studying abroad incognito or something」

name: Ria
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe your sister's being cautious because it could turn into an international incident」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha... No way, that's impossible\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「It'd be pretty interesting if that were the case, though」

name: Ria
message: 「Interesting, sure, though I'd probably be too shocked\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san did ask me to look after her, too, but even putting all that aside, I just genuinely want to be her friend」

name: Ria
message: 「Aaaah~~. Don't tell me you've got a crush on her~~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat」

name: Ria
message: 「Aaalright. As your senpai, I'll cheer the two of you on!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You really don't need to do that!」

name: Ria
message: 「Aw, too bad. Juuust kidding\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on... give me a break」

name: Ria
message: 「No getting a head start on me, okay\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll be fine, probably...」

name: Ria
message: 「Pro-ba-bly?」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah! Th-that was just a figure of speech!」

name: Ria
message: 「Teehee, your senpai sees right through everything, ahem!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha\s02 I'm no match for you, Ria-senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「Achoo!」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai?」
What was that adorable sneeze just now.

name: Ria
message: 「Oh no, I'll catch a cold talking on the phone dressed like this. I need to put some clothes on properly, ehehe」
D-dressed like this... could it be!?

name: Ria
message: 「I'm glad you seem to be doing well, Synn-kun♪ Well, see you tomorrow」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, uh, y-yes」

name: Ria
message: 「If anything troubles you, feel free to talk to me anytime. Bye-bye」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes... goodbye, then」

name: Ria
message: 「Achoo!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm hanging up now\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, go ahead\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「W-well then~」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone's super motivated. I've gotta do my best too」

name: Paqy
message: 「Student Council work looks surprisingly tough, man」

name: Synn
message: 「There's still tons of stuff we need to get done, after all. If I handle it all properly, a rosy school life is sure to await!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... So you plan to bring Ryuusei Academy under your control first, huh? Expected nothing less from you, Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「All right! Let's eat a hearty dinner and get energized. Tonight's menu is curry rice!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Your bento was curry too, wasn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's been curry all week」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh... Blood will tell」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy, don't you want any?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Of course I'll dig in!」
